content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TNAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for TNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the TNAU Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 16 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for which TNAU is recruiting?
faq.answer: TNAU is recruiting for the posts of Research Associate and Food Analyst.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for these posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by TNAU for the Research Associate and Food Analyst positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: For the Research Associate position, candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Agriculture, Microbiology, Biotechnology, or Environmental Science.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the Food Analyst post?
faq.answer: The Food Analyst position requires a Post Graduate degree in a relevant science course with demonstrated analytical skills.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Associate post varies based on experience, ranging from Rs. 58,000/- p.m. for the first year to Rs. 67,000/- p.m. for the third year, provided the candidate has NET qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Food Analyst post?
faq.answer: The Food Analyst post offers a consolidated salary of Rs. 27,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for TNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these TNAU posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions at TNAU will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.
